faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AI0FY.
faq.a1: AI0FY is a universal AI gateway that provides a single API endpoint to access 290+ AI providers. It handles multi-provider fallback, prompt compression, rate limiting, subscription management, and multi-tenant architecture out of the box.
faq.a2: When a request to your primary provider fails due to an outage, rate limit, or error, AI0FY automatically routes the request to a fallback provider you’ve configured. This ensures zero downtime for your AI features without any code changes on your end.
faq.a3: AI0FY supports 290+ providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, Cohere, and many more. We continuously add new providers as they become available. You can browse the full list on our providers page.
faq.a4: AI0FY offers a free tier with 100,000 tokens per month. Paid plans start at $20/month and include higher rate limits, priority support, and advanced features like prompt compression and custom guardrails. We only charge for tokens processed through our gateway.
faq.q5: Is AI0FY compatible with the OpenAI SDK?
faq.a5: Yes. AI0FY is fully compatible with the OpenAI SDK. Simply change the base URL to https://api.ai0fy.dev/v1 and use your AI0FY API key. All existing code continues to work while gaining access to 290+ providers and automatic fallback.
faq.a6: Prompt compression reduces the size of your prompts by removing redundant tokens while preserving semantic meaning. AI0FY’s compression can reduce token usage by up to 60%, significantly lowering costs without sacrificing output quality.
faq.a7: Each user gets a unique API key from the dashboard. Keys are used to authenticate requests, track usage, and enforce rate limits. You can create multiple keys for different environments (development, staging, production) and revoke them individually.
faq.q8: Do you offer a multi-tenant architecture?
faq.a8: Yes. AI0FY is built on a multi-tenant architecture, allowing you to create isolated sub-accounts for different customers, teams, or environments. Each tenant has its own API keys, rate limits, usage tracking, and provider configurations.
faq.a9: Enterprise plans include self-hosting options. You can deploy AI0FY on your own infrastructure with full control over data residency, compliance, and security. Contact our sales team for more information.
faq.q10: What kind of support is available?
faq.a10: Free tier users get community support via Discord. Pro users get email support with 4-hour response time. Enterprise customers get dedicated Slack channels, priority support, and a named account manager.
